offering_description.value: Owns and operates casino, hotel, dining, entertainment and gaming properties serving the Las Vegas locals market, led by Red Rock Casino Resort and Station Casinos brands. Customers are individual gamblers and guests who pay at the properties, which the company owns and runs itself.

primary_services.value: casino gaming; hotel rooms; food and beverage; entertainment and events; bowling and movie theaters

customer_segment.value: B2C: Las Vegas-area local residents and visitors who gamble, dine, stay and attend entertainment

revenue_model.value: service fees: casino wagering, hotel stays, restaurants and bars, entertainment and other amenities; commissions or management fees: management fees from managed Native American casino
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates casino resort properties in the Las Vegas valley, selling to consumers; service provider: manages a casino for a Native American tribe under management agreement

geography_served.value: US regional: Las Vegas valley, Nevada

specialization.value: related lines: casino gaming, lodging, dining, entertainment, plus casino management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: casino resorts and neighborhood casinos in the Las Vegas valley; online: mobile app and website for loyalty program and promotions

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gaming licenses required from Nevada Gaming Commission and Nevada Gaming Control Board, liquor licensing
